title: Make empty-seat bot-fill configurable per GDD §3.2 ("o se excluyen, configurable") + own it in the FSM class doc
description: Filed from the TASK-069 review (rev-t069 MEDIUM-1). TASK-069 wired SessionStateMachine.CompleteJoin to ALWAYS fill every unclaimed seat with a Novato bot (SessionStateMachine.cs:695, `seats[i] = _ready[i] ? Human : Bot;`) — unconditional, no config, no min-human guard, built exactly to TASK-069's AC1. But GDD §3.2 (line 48) frames this as a CONFIGURABLE choice, not a mandate: 'los puestos vacíos se rellenan con bots de nivel novato ruidoso O SE EXCLUYEN DE LA RONDA, CONFIGURABLE', around a '2, 3 o 4 jugadores activos' (human-presence) premise; D.3 says 'rellena puestos vacíos en partida real'. The current hardcode drops both the configurability and the human-presence framing: a credit-then-zero-claims session now spins up a full 4-bot game (FinalWager, bonus-star draw, 4-bot podium, pays bots coins). rev-t069 judged this NON-corrupting and bounded (InsertCredit is the only Attract->Join path, so an empty bar stays in Attract; clean GameOver->Attract reset) — NOT a HIGH — but a genuine undocumented GDD divergence on the shared FSM.\n\nWORK (pending HUMAN ratification of the intended default): (1) HUMAN decides the §3.2 policy — always-fill (current), exclude-empty, or a min-human-count guard (e.g. only fill when >=1 human claimed). (2) Add a `fillEmptySeatsWithBots` (or equivalent) config dimension — likely on SessionStateMachineConfig — realizing §3.2's 'configurable', defaulting to whatever the human ratifies. (3) Amend the SessionStateMachine class doc (SessionStateMachine.cs:256-267), which currently cites only D.3's 'rellena puestos vacíos' and silently omits §3.2's 'o se excluyen... configurable' alternative + the human-presence premise — own the configurability instead of hardcoding it away. (4) Optional cleanup (rev-t069 LOW-1): sibling historical cross-refs to the deleted EsquivaEscapeBot at ReactionDelayBuffer.cs:21, EsquivaMicrogameV2Tests.cs:444 and :757 — all past-tense/non-false (NOT the AC4-fixed 'still present verbatim' claim), optional tidy. Core/engine-free, fast-testable.
acceptance_criteria: HUMAN ratifies the §3.2 empty-seat policy (always-fill / exclude / min-human-guard) and it is recorded
A config dimension (e.g. SessionStateMachineConfig.fillEmptySeatsWithBots) realizes §3.2's 'configurable', with the ratified default; CompleteJoin honors it (test the non-default path)
The SessionStateMachine class doc owns the configurability + human-presence premise (no longer silently hardcoding one option); GDD §3.2 citation added
Fast suite green, no regression; the 0-human-claims session behavior matches the ratified policy under test
